tara: Heads-up  Snowflake asked for a compatibility matrix for our connector variants (Snowbridge vs hosted sidecar) before we schedule marketplace listing. Need a brief doc and perf numbers.

jose: I'll pull perf numbers today. Quick ask  include quantized vs fp32 token/sec and memory footprint for 512/2048 seq.

mina: Also confirm install UX: delegated-role vs service-account flows. Snowflake wants least-privilege examples in the listing.

devops-bot: New artifact uploaded: s3://ci-artifacts/connector-bench-179777.zip. Contains perf CSVs and packaging notes.

jose: Got the artifact, samples look good. I'll summarize top-line numbers and link into the listing checklist.

tara: Thanks. Can we get the compatibility matrix + one-pager by Thu EOD? Snowflake PM wants it for their Friday review.

mina: I'll draft the least-privilege quickstart and add code snippets for role creation. Will share by Thu morning.

jose: I'll validate perf numbers against latest nightly and post final CSV link.

tara: Perfect. If partners sign off after their review, we'll open the marketplace listing window next week.
